beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Six days after graduating dead last, Naruto Uzumaki is doing the Hokage's paperwork. All of it. With two hundred copies of himself.
beats.spokenText: [flat, deadpan] Six days after graduating dead last, Nah-roo-toh Oo-zoo-mah-kee is doing the Hoh-kah-geh's paperwork. All of it. With two hundred copies of himself.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, this report just stops in the middle of a sentence. Is that normal?
beats.spokenText: Boss, this report just stops in the middle of a sentence. Is that normal?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Yeah. Read the next one.
beats.spokenText: Yeah. Read the next one.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Twenty years of mission reports. Every ambush. Every mistake. Every ninja who never came home. And he'll remember all of it.
beats.spokenText: [low, steady] Twenty years of mission reports. Every ambush. Every mistake. Every ninja who never came home. And he'll remember all of it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Because every shadow clone sends its memories back when it pops. That's not a what-if. In canon, nobody tells Naruto until he's sixteen.
beats.spokenText: [even, factual] Because every shadow clone sends its memories back when it pops. That's not a what-if. In canon, nobody tells Nah-roo-toh until he's sixteen.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: So this isn't a power-up story. The rule is simple. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.
beats.spokenText: So this isn't a power-up story. The rule is simple. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: That's six days from now. Tonight he's twelve, filthy, and alone in a forest with a stolen scroll. And he's about to read one more line.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] That's six days from now. Tonight he's twelve, filthy, and alone in a forest with a stolen scroll. And he's about to read one more line.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Midnight. A clearing deep in the forest. Naruto has a hundred bruises and, at last, one perfect clone.
beats.spokenText: [tired, wry] Midnight. A clearing deep in the forest. Nah-roo-toh has a hundred bruises and, at last, one perfect clone.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Okay. Okay! Look at that. It even has my stupid face.
beats.spokenText: Okay. Okay! Look at that. It even has my stupid face.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: That's my stupid face! Boss, we did it!
beats.spokenText: That's my stupid face! Boss, we did it!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: They grin at each other. The clone steps back to celebrate, and the root behind him doesn't step back.
beats.spokenText: [dry] They grin at each other. The clone steps back to celebrate, and the root behind him doesn't step back.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Whoa, whoa, whoa—
beats.spokenText: Whoa, whoa, whoa—

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Pop. Ten feet away, Naruto yelps and grabs his own knee. It's scraped raw.
beats.spokenText: Pop. Ten feet away, Nah-roo-toh yelps and grabs his own knee. It's scraped raw.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Ow. Wait. I didn't fall.
beats.spokenText: [slow realisation] Ow. Wait. I didn't fall.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He looks down. Under the hand seals, in cramped brushwork, there's a note he was about to roll right past.
beats.spokenText: He looks down. Under the hand seals, in cramped brushwork, there's a note he was about to roll right past.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Shadow Clone Jutsu was invented by the Second Hokage, Tobirama, for scouting enemy ground. Naruto learned it in a few hours.
beats.spokenText: [grave] The Shadow Clone joot-soo was invented by the Second Hoh-kah-geh, Toh-bee-rah-mah, for scouting enemy ground. Nah-roo-toh learned it in a few hours.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The note is six lines long. What the clone learns, the caster keeps. For this reason the technique is forbidden. The mind fails long before the chakra does.
beats.spokenText: [reading aloud, slow] The note is six lines long. What the clone learns, the caster keeps. For this reason the technique is forbidden. The mind fails long before the chah-krah does.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: So everything he learns, I learn. Everything.
beats.spokenText: So everything he learns, I learn. Everything.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: A twelve year old with more chakra than anyone alive has just found a cheat code. Four years early.
beats.spokenText: A twelve year old with more chah-krah than anyone alive has just found a cheat code. Four years early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He doesn't celebrate. He runs an experiment. One clone, the next page of the scroll, and a long walk around a tree.
beats.spokenText: [brisk] He doesn't celebrate. He runs an experiment. One clone, the next page of the scroll, and a long walk around a tree.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Pop me when I'm done. I wanna see if it works!
beats.spokenText: Pop me when I'm done. I wanna see if it works!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Reading, reading. Ooh, this seal is nasty. Okay, I see how it works.
beats.spokenText: Reading, reading. Ooh, this seal is nasty. Okay, I see how it works.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto pokes him with a stick. Pop. And he knows the seal. Not read it. Knows it.
beats.spokenText: [amazed] Nah-roo-toh pokes him with a stick. Pop. And he knows the seal. Not read it. Knows it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Wait. I can be in two classes at once.
beats.spokenText: Wait. I can be in two classes at once.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Ya know what? I can be in all of them!
beats.spokenText: Ya know what? I can be in all of them!

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Naruto! There you are! Do you have any idea what you've done?
beats.spokenText: [furious, relieved] Nah-roo-toh! There you are! Do you have any idea what you've done?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Mizuki-sensei? You said if I learned one jutsu from this, I'd pass!
beats.spokenText: [confused, hopeful] Mee-zoo-kee-sen-say? You said if I learned one joot-soo from this, I'd pass!

beats.speaker: MIZUKI
beats.captionText: Give me the scroll, Naruto. You've done exactly what I needed. It was never meant for a fool like you.
beats.spokenText: Give me the scroll, Nah-roo-toh. You've done exactly what I needed. It was never meant for a fool like you.

beats.speaker: MIZUKI
beats.captionText: Twelve years ago the Nine Tails destroyed this village. And you're the fox, Naruto. Everyone knew but you.
beats.spokenText: Twelve years ago the Nine Tails destroyed this village. And you're the fox, Nah-roo-toh. Everyone knew but you.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Mizuki hurls a giant shuriken at the boy. Naruto can't move. It never lands. Iruka is over him, the blade buried in his own back.
beats.spokenText: Mee-zoo-kee hurls a giant shuriken at the boy. Nah-roo-toh can't move. It never lands. Ee-roo-kah is over him, the blade buried in his own back.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto goes very still. Iruka, bleeding, doesn't look at the boy at all. He looks at Mizuki.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh goes very still. Ee-roo-kah, bleeding, doesn't look at the boy at all. He looks at Mee-zoo-kee.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: He's not the demon fox. He's Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf. And he's my student.
beats.spokenText: [over his shoulder, to Mizuki] He's not the demon fox. He's Nah-roo-toh Oo-zoo-mah-kee of the Hidden Leaf. And he's my student.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Mizuki charges. Naruto answers with the one jutsu he learned tonight. The clearing fills with a thousand of him.
beats.spokenText: Mee-zoo-kee charges. Nah-roo-toh answers with the one joot-soo he learned tonight. The clearing fills with a thousand of him.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Come on, Mizuki! Pick one! Pick any one!
beats.spokenText: Come on, Mee-zoo-kee! Pick one! Pick any one!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Mizuki goes down under a mountain of orange. Then the clones disperse, and a thousand memories come home at once.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, awed] Mee-zoo-kee goes down under a mountain of orange. Then the clones disperse, and a thousand memories come home at once.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The same moment, from a thousand angles. Mizuki's fist. The moon. And Iruka's face, crying, a thousand times over.
beats.spokenText: [hushed, wondering] The same moment, from a thousand angles. Mee-zoo-kee's fist. The moon. And Ee-roo-kah's face, crying, a thousand times over.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The first person who ever chose him. And Naruto gets to keep every single copy.
beats.spokenText: The first person who ever chose him. And Nah-roo-toh gets to keep every single copy.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He drops to his knees and is sick in the grass. Iruka thinks it's chakra exhaustion.
beats.spokenText: [gentle, dry] He drops to his knees and is sick in the grass. Ee-roo-kah thinks it's chah-krah exhaustion.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Easy. Breathe. You overdid it, that's all.
beats.spokenText: Easy. Breathe. You overdid it, that's all.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: It's not that, sensei. I just saw your face. A thousand times.
beats.spokenText: It's not that, sen-say. I just saw your face. A thousand times.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Close your eyes, Naruto. I've something for you.
beats.spokenText: [warm, wincing] Close your eyes, Nah-roo-toh. I've something for you.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Congratulations. You graduate.
beats.spokenText: Congratulations. You graduate.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: That's your headband. You can't give me your headband!
beats.spokenText: That's your headband. You can't give me your headband!

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: I can get another one. You only graduate once.
beats.spokenText: [warm] I can get another one. You only graduate once.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Nobody ever stayed to see me finish anything.
beats.spokenText: Nobody ever stayed to see me finish anything.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Then I'll stay for the next one.
beats.spokenText: Then I'll stay for the next one.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Everyone else remembers one graduation night. Naruto gets to remember it a thousand times.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, final] Everyone else remembers one graduation night. Nah-roo-toh gets to remember it a thousand times.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Morning. He should be asleep. Instead he's on the Academy roof with twenty clones, testing the rules.
beats.spokenText: Morning. He should be asleep. Instead he's on the Academy roof with twenty clones, testing the rules.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Rule one. The knowing comes back. The muscles don't. Skill yes, strength no.
beats.spokenText: Rule one. The knowing comes back. The muscles don't. Skill yes, strength no.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Okay, rule three. A clone that gets hit pops. So who's gonna get punched?
beats.spokenText: [scheming] Okay, rule three. A clone that gets hit pops. So who's gonna get punched?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Not me. I got punched last time.
beats.spokenText: Not me. I got punched last time.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: You're the same person!
beats.spokenText: You're the same person!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Then it doesn't matter who!
beats.spokenText: [triumphant logic] Then it doesn't matter who!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Somebody gets punched. Pop. On the roof, Naruto winces for a face that isn't his. Rule three, confirmed. He keeps the hit.
beats.spokenText: Somebody gets punched. Pop. On the roof, Nah-roo-toh winces for a face that isn't his. Rule three, confirmed. He keeps the hit.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Okay. We all feel it. Nobody gets punched twice!
beats.spokenText: Okay. We all feel it. Nobody gets punched twice!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Rule four. Every clone carries a share of my chakra.
beats.spokenText: [reading from a list] Rule four. Every clone carries a share of my chah-krah.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Then why do I feel hungry?
beats.spokenText: Then why do I feel hungry?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Because we're all hungry. We're one stomach.
beats.spokenText: Because we're all hungry. We're one stomach.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Rule four he underlines twice. Every clone carries a share of his chakra. And his chakra has a lodger.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] Rule four he underlines twice. Every clone carries a share of his chah-krah. And his chah-krah has a lodger.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Rule two is less funny. Every clone's tiredness comes back too, all at once. Fifty clones for an hour is a fifty hour headache.
beats.spokenText: [grim, counting] Rule two is less funny. Every clone's tiredness comes back too, all at once. Fifty clones for an hour is a fifty hour headache.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. One hour. Everyone pops at the same time, right?
beats.spokenText: Boss. One hour. Everyone pops at the same time, right?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: That's the plan.
beats.spokenText: [cheerful] That's the plan.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: That's a terrible plan.
beats.spokenText: That's a terrible plan.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Everybody dispel on three!
beats.spokenText: Everybody dispel on three!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Wait. Is it on three, or after three?
beats.spokenText: [anxious] Wait. Is it on three, or after three?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: It's on three! Why is that hard?!
beats.spokenText: [exasperated] It's on three! Why is that hard?!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He tries it anyway. Fifty clones, one hour, all dispelled together. Naruto is unconscious for nineteen hours.
beats.spokenText: [flat] He tries it anyway. Fifty clones, one hour, all dispelled together. Nah-roo-toh is unconscious for nineteen hours.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Ugh. Why is there a crow on my chest?
beats.spokenText: Ugh. Why is there a crow on my chest?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Okay. Batches. Batches of ten.
beats.spokenText: Okay. Batches. Batches of ten.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Right. Every class I ever slept through. Everything I missed. Go!
beats.spokenText: [fired up] Right. Every class I ever slept through. Everything I missed. Go!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Twenty clones take notes in the back of every classroom. Somewhere a teacher wonders why his worst student has so many cousins.
beats.spokenText: Twenty clones take notes in the back of every classroom. Somewhere a teacher wonders why his worst student has so many cousins.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The library throws him out. He's that boy. So thirty clones walk back in, transformed into thirty different old men.
beats.spokenText: The library throws him out. He's that boy. So thirty clones walk back in, transformed into thirty different old men.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Good afternoon, sir. Where might I find the chakra control primer?
beats.spokenText: [fake old man voice] Good afternoon, sir. Where might I find the chah-krah control primer?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: What a coincidence. I'm also looking for that book.
beats.spokenText: What a coincidence. I'm also looking for that book.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: One librarian notices that all thirty old men are reading the same beginner's primer. Four of them are holding it upside down.
beats.spokenText: [bone dry] One librarian notices that all thirty old men are reading the same beginner's primer. Four of them are holding it upside down.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Then leaf exercises, times two hundred. And he finally learns why his clone jutsu always failed.
beats.spokenText: [building] Then leaf exercises, times two hundred. And he finally learns why his clone joot-soo always failed.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: It was never too little chakra! It was way too much, shoved through a pinhole!
beats.spokenText: It was never too little chah-krah! It was way too much, shoved through a pinhole!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Two hundred clones, ten hours each. That's two thousand hours of practice a day. Most genin don't train that much in a year.
beats.spokenText: Two hundred clones, ten hours each. That's two thousand hours of practice a day. Most geh-nin don't train that much in a year.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: That evening Iruka takes him to Ichiraku, the way he does when he's worried. Naruto orders his usual and, for once, chews with his mouth closed.
beats.spokenText: [warm] That evening Ee-roo-kah takes him to Ee-chee-rah-koo, the way he does when he's worried. Nah-roo-toh orders his usual and, for once, chews with his mouth closed.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Eat slower. Nobody's going to take your bowl.
beats.spokenText: Eat slower. Nobody's going to take your bowl.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old habit.
beats.spokenText: Old habit.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Quick question, Naruto. Who founded the Hidden Leaf?
beats.spokenText: [casual, testing] Quick question, Nah-roo-toh. Who founded the Hidden Leaf?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Hashirama Senju and Madara Uchiha. Then the Second Hokage, Tobirama. Who invented my jutsu, by the way.
beats.spokenText: Hah-shee-rah-mah Sen-joo and Mah-dah-rah Oo-chee-hah. Then the Second Hoh-kah-geh, Toh-bee-rah-mah. Who invented my joot-soo, by the way.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Say that again. Slowly.
beats.spokenText: [coughing] Say that again. Slowly.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Naruto. Where did you learn all this?
beats.spokenText: [amazed] Nah-roo-toh. Where did you learn all this?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Everywhere. Mostly the library. They're really nice there, once you're old.
beats.spokenText: Everywhere. Mostly the library. They're really nice there, once you're old.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He knows which shops will serve him, and at what hour. He knows people by their footsteps, because nobody ever walked toward him.
beats.spokenText: He knows which shops will serve him, and at what hour. He knows people by their footsteps, because nobody ever walked toward him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: On the tower above, the Third Hokage watches it all in his crystal ball, pipe in hand.
beats.spokenText: [calm] On the tower above, the Third Hoh-kah-geh watches it all in his crystal ball, pipe in hand.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: His left hand has formed a cross seal on the desk. He doesn't seem to notice. It's an old habit.
beats.spokenText: His left hand has formed a cross seal on the desk. He doesn't seem to notice. It's an old habit.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Two thousand hours a day. Hm. That explains the librarian.
beats.spokenText: Two thousand hours a day. Hm. That explains the librarian.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He isn't angry. He's doing the same arithmetic. And looking at the paperwork on his own desk.
beats.spokenText: [sly] He isn't angry. He's doing the same arithmetic. And looking at the paperwork on his own desk.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The summons comes at dawn. Naruto walks into the Hokage's office braced to be yelled at.
beats.spokenText: The summons comes at dawn. Nah-roo-toh walks into the Hoh-kah-geh's office braced to be yelled at.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old man, I can explain! Okay, I can't. But I learned a jutsu, so technically I passed, ya know!
beats.spokenText: Old man, I can explain! Okay, I can't. But I learned a joot-soo, so technically I passed, ya know!

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Stealing the Scroll of Seals is a crime, Naruto. The sentence is one month of filing duty in my archive.
beats.spokenText: [gentle, tired] Stealing the Scroll of Seals is a crime, Nah-roo-toh. The sentence is one month of filing duty in my archive.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Unclassified mission reports only. Every shelf, every box.
beats.spokenText: Unclassified mission reports only. Every shelf, every box.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Filing?! I'm a ninja now!
beats.spokenText: Filing?! I'm a ninja now!

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Then file like one.
beats.spokenText: [gentle steel] Then file like one.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: A month? Old man, I could do a month in a day.
beats.spokenText: A month? Old man, I could do a month in a day.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I know. That's rather the point.
beats.spokenText: I know. That's rather the point.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Can I at least have a lunch break?
beats.spokenText: [pleading] Can I at least have a lunch break?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: You may have an hour. Your clones may have the next five.
beats.spokenText: You may have an hour. Your clones may have the next five.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: First, a staff form. Name, office, position. Paperwork, Naruto. Get used to it.
beats.spokenText: First, a staff form. Name, office, position. Paperwork, Nah-roo-toh. Get used to it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Fine. Filing clerk. Naruto Uzumaki. Where's the punishment part?
beats.spokenText: [grumbling] Fine. Filing clerk. Nah-roo-toh Oo-zoo-mah-kee. Where's the punishment part?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: You're standing in it.
beats.spokenText: You're standing in it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It's the first official form that has ever carried his name, and he signs it twice by accident.
beats.spokenText: It's the first official form that has ever carried his name, and he signs it twice by accident.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Third's reasons are two. Keep the boy where the old man can see him.
beats.spokenText: [reflective] The Third's reasons are two. Keep the boy where the old man can see him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: And let a lonely child be, for once, inside the building instead of outside the window.
beats.spokenText: [soft] And let a lonely child be, for once, inside the building instead of outside the window.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Day one. Two hundred Narutos enter the archive. It is, structurally, a fire hazard.
beats.spokenText: Day one. Two hundred Narutos enter the archive. It is, structurally, a fire hazard.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Pass it down! Pass it down! Do not drop it, it's older than us!
beats.spokenText: [frantic] Pass it down! Pass it down! Do not drop it, it's older than us!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Why is there a stamp on your forehead?
beats.spokenText: Why is there a stamp on your forehead?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: He needed a flat surface!
beats.spokenText: He needed a flat surface!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: I found a portrait of somebody very old. Where does it go?
beats.spokenText: [muffled, from under a shelf] I found a portrait of somebody very old. Where does it go?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: With the other old things.
beats.spokenText: With the other old things.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: That's the Third Hokage.
beats.spokenText: That's the Third Hoh-kah-geh.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Do not say that out loud!
beats.spokenText: [panicked] Do not say that out loud!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, where do I put the Hokage's hat?
beats.spokenText: Boss, where do I put the Hoh-kah-geh's hat?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Under H!
beats.spokenText: Under H!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: For Hat or for Hokage?
beats.spokenText: [genuinely asking] For Hat or for Hoh-kah-geh?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Yes! Both!
beats.spokenText: Yes! Both!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By noon, a bucket chain of clones is passing scrolls from the basement to the third floor, out one window and in through another. Nobody tells them there are stairs.
beats.spokenText: By noon, a bucket chain of clones is passing scrolls from the basement to the third floor, out one window and in through another. Nobody tells them there are stairs.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By night, the Third Hokage's in tray is empty. For the first time in thirty years.
beats.spokenText: [gleeful] By night, the Third Hoh-kah-geh's in tray is empty. For the first time in thirty years.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old man! Your in-tray's empty. What do we do now?
beats.spokenText: [cheerful] Old man! Your in-tray's empty. What do we do now?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I don't know. That has never happened.
beats.spokenText: [genuinely baffled] I don't know. That has never happened.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Is that my desk? I'd forgotten it was wood.
beats.spokenText: [wondering] Is that my desk? I'd forgotten it was wood.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Years from now, as Seventh Hokage, Naruto will run this same office with shadow clones. He's just starting early.
beats.spokenText: [amused] Years from now, as Seventh Hoh-kah-geh, Nah-roo-toh will run this same office with shadow clones. He's just starting early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Then the mail desk. Diplomatic letters from every hidden village, sorted by hand and filed by date.
beats.spokenText: Then the mail desk. Diplomatic letters from every hidden village, sorted by hand and filed by date.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, why does the Fourth Kazekage sign like he's stabbing the page?
beats.spokenText: [baffled] Boss, why does the Fourth Kah-zeh-kah-geh sign like he's stabbing the page?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: He presses so hard the brush splits. Look at every downstroke!
beats.spokenText: He presses so hard the brush splits. Look at every downstroke!

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Ha. He has always been a hard man. File it under S for Sand.
beats.spokenText: Ha. He has always been a hard man. File it under S for Sand.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old man, can I keep that letter? It's the best thing I've ever read.
beats.spokenText: [delighted] Old man, can I keep that letter? It's the best thing I've ever read.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: No. It's a diplomatic document.
beats.spokenText: [dry] No. It's a diplomatic document.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Worth a shot.
beats.spokenText: [unbothered] Worth a shot.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto thinks it's the funniest thing he has read all week. He files it under S, and moves on to the next.
beats.spokenText: [light] Nah-roo-toh thinks it's the funniest thing he has read all week. He files it under S, and moves on to the next.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: As punishments go, it is a strange one. Nobody has ever handed Naruto a key before.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, final] As punishments go, it is a strange one. Nobody has ever handed Nah-roo-toh a key before.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: On the second day, the Third Hokage walks past the archive door and counts forty Narutos reading in complete silence. He keeps walking. Then he walks back to check.
beats.spokenText: On the second day, the Third Hoh-kah-geh walks past the archive door and counts forty Narutos reading in complete silence. He keeps walking. Then he walks back to check.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By the fourth day, it stops being funny. Mission reports aren't stories. They're after-action reports.
beats.spokenText: [grave] By the fourth day, it stops being funny. Mission reports aren't stories. They're after-action reports.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Every ambush that worked. Every formation that failed. Every report that ends in the middle of a sentence.
beats.spokenText: Every ambush that worked. Every formation that failed. Every report that ends in the middle of a sentence.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. Three separate reports on one cat. The last one just says, never again.
beats.spokenText: Boss. Three separate reports on one cat. The last one just says, never again.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: File them under tragedies.
beats.spokenText: [dry] File them under tragedies.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, here's one where the cat bit a chunin. Pretty hard.
beats.spokenText: [reading] Boss, here's one where the cat bit a choo-nin. Pretty hard.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Respect the cat.
beats.spokenText: [grave] Respect the cat.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Every ambush has the same shape. They always hit the last man first.
beats.spokenText: Every ambush has the same shape. They always hit the last man first.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: So we put somebody useless at the back.
beats.spokenText: So we put somebody useless at the back.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Nobody's useless at the back. Put somebody who's paying attention.
beats.spokenText: [firm] Nobody's useless at the back. Put somebody who's paying attention.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Look. Three teams were hit on the same road. Always the same corner.
beats.spokenText: Look. Three teams were hit on the same road. Always the same corner.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: So somebody should have checked the corner.
beats.spokenText: So somebody should have checked the corner.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Somebody did. They wrote it down. Nobody read it.
beats.spokenText: [quiet anger] Somebody did. They wrote it down. Nobody read it.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. Why does nobody read these?
beats.spokenText: Boss. Why does nobody read these?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: 'Cause it's easier to be brave than to be prepared.
beats.spokenText: 'Cause it's easier to be brave than to be prepared.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, two reports disagree about the same fight.
beats.spokenText: [puzzled] Boss, two reports disagree about the same fight.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Then one of them was scared, or both were. Read both.
beats.spokenText: Then one of them was scared, or both were. Read both.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. This one is signed by somebody who never came back.
beats.spokenText: Boss. This one is signed by somebody who never came back.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Read the names out loud. Somebody oughta.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] Read the names out loud. Somebody oughta.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Two hundred voices read them aloud, quietly, one after another. Nobody has done that for any of them.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] Two hundred voices read them aloud, quietly, one after another. Nobody has done that for any of them.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Most genin learn from one teacher. Naruto is learning from every shinobi who ever came home. And a few who didn't.
beats.spokenText: Most geh-nin learn from one teacher. Nah-roo-toh is learning from every shee-noh-bee who ever came home. And a few who didn't.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He goes quiet. For the first time in his life, Naruto Uzumaki isn't the loudest person in the room.
beats.spokenText: [soft] He goes quiet. For the first time in his life, Nah-roo-toh Oo-zoo-mah-kee isn't the loudest person in the room.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. C-rank escort. The last line says, puddle on the road, no rain for a week.
beats.spokenText: Boss. C-rank escort. The last line says, puddle on the road, no rain for a week.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Mark that one. Don't ask me why. It just feels like a sentence that's got a second half.
beats.spokenText: Mark that one. Don't ask me why. It just feels like a sentence that's got a second half.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He starts to read what isn't there. One week in October, twelve years ago, where every file is in a different clerk's handwriting.
beats.spokenText: [low] He starts to read what isn't there. One week in October, twelve years ago, where every file is in a different clerk's handwriting.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, that whole shelf is marked off limits. By the Third himself.
beats.spokenText: Boss, that whole shelf is marked off limits. By the Third himself.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Off limits. Huh. Leave it. For now.
beats.spokenText: Off limits. Huh. Leave it. For now.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Naruto, it's midnight. Go home.
beats.spokenText: [tired, kind] Nah-roo-toh, it's midnight. Go home.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: One more shelf, sensei. Please.
beats.spokenText: One more shelf, sen-say. Please.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Are all of those you?
beats.spokenText: Are all of those you?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Yes. Do not tell the old man.
beats.spokenText: [sheepish] Yes. Do not tell the old man.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Naruto. The old man signed your form. He knows.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh. The old man signed your form. He knows.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Then, on the sixth day, a clone in the back corner finds a thin folder. Kakashi Hatake. Jonin instructor evaluations.
beats.spokenText: Then, on the sixth day, a clone in the back corner finds a thin folder. Kah-kah-shee Hah-tah-keh. joh-nin instructor evaluations.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kakashi Hatake has never passed a team. Every genin he ever tested went straight back to the Academy.
beats.spokenText: [dry] Kah-kah-shee Hah-tah-keh has never passed a team. Every geh-nin he ever tested went straight back to the Academy.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, every one says the same thing. Failed. Could not work together.
beats.spokenText: Boss, every one says the same thing. Failed. Could not work together.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: And eleven reports say Kakashi Hatake arrived late. Eleven.
beats.spokenText: And eleven reports say Kah-kah-shee Hah-tah-keh arrived late. Eleven.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: So he's late a lot. So what?
beats.spokenText: [shrugging] So he's late a lot. So what?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: No. Look at the dates.
beats.spokenText: No. Look at the dates.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Huh. Same dates. Every year. Nobody's that unlucky.
beats.spokenText: Huh. Same dates. Every year. Nobody's that unlucky.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He writes the dates in the margin of his notebook. Then, because tomorrow is team assignments, he turns the page.
beats.spokenText: [light] He writes the dates in the margin of his notebook. Then, because tomorrow is team assignments, he turns the page.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Most students walk into a test with a pencil. Naruto will walk in with the teacher's whole file.
beats.spokenText: [gleeful] Most students walk into a test with a pencil. Nah-roo-toh will walk in with the teacher's whole file.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Team Seven. Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura. Their jonin instructor, Kakashi Hatake, orders them to the training ground at dawn for a survival test. No breakfast.
beats.spokenText: Team Seven. Nah-roo-toh, Sah-skeh, Sah-koo-rah. Their joh-nin instructor, Kah-kah-shee Hah-tah-keh, orders them to the training ground at dawn for a survival test. No breakfast.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kakashi Hatake will not be there at dawn. He is late to everything.
beats.spokenText: [deadpan] Kah-kah-shee Hah-tah-keh will not be there at dawn. He is late to everything.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto knows. It's in eleven reports. Which gives him the training ground, three hours, and two hundred clones.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh knows. It's in eleven reports. Which gives him the training ground, three hours, and two hundred clones.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By the time the others arrive there are fourteen wires, six trenches, and one very confused squirrel.
beats.spokenText: By the time the others arrive there are fourteen wires, six trenches, and one very confused squirrel.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, the squirrel is still in the net.
beats.spokenText: [reporting] Boss, the squirrel is still in the net.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Leave him. He's a witness.
beats.spokenText: Leave him. He's a witness.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Why are you standing in a ditch?
beats.spokenText: Why are you standing in a ditch?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Listen, both of you. It's a teamwork test. He's failed every team before us. I know 'cause I filed the paperwork.
beats.spokenText: [fast, urgent] Listen, both of you. It's a teamwork test. He's failed every team before us. I know 'cause I filed the paperwork.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: You're dead last. Why would I believe you?
beats.spokenText: You're dead last. Why would I believe you?

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: Nobody knows what the test is, Naruto. And honestly? You're annoying. Why would I trust you?
beats.spokenText: Nobody knows what the test is, Nah-roo-toh. And honestly? You're annoying. Why would I trust you?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Because I've never lied to you. Okay, three times. This isn't one of them.
beats.spokenText: Because I've never lied to you. Okay, three times. This isn't one of them.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: If this goes wrong, I'm blaming you.
beats.spokenText: If this goes wrong, I'm blaming you.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Fair. Blame me. I'll be right next to you.
beats.spokenText: [easy] Fair. Blame me. I'll be right next to you.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: I don't need a team.
beats.spokenText: I don't need a team.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Good. Me neither. I just need you to listen.
beats.spokenText: Good. Me neither. I just need you to listen.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Knowing the answer is useless if nobody will listen. The obstacle was never power. It is trust.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, firm] Knowing the answer is useless if nobody will listen. The obstacle was never power. It is trust.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Fine. Here's the deal. Whatever bells we get, you two take them. I'll be the one who goes back to the Academy.
beats.spokenText: Fine. Here's the deal. Whatever bells we get, you two take them. I'll be the one who goes back to the Academy.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I just need two of us to pass.
beats.spokenText: I just need two of us to pass.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: Naruto. You would really do that?
beats.spokenText: [stunned, soft] Nah-roo-toh. You would really do that?

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Hm. Fine. Stop talking and show me the plan.
beats.spokenText: Hm. Fine. Stop talking and show me the plan.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kakashi strolls in, book open, and finds three genin waiting in a perfect triangle. He turns a page.
beats.spokenText: Kah-kah-shee strolls in, book open, and finds three geh-nin waiting in a perfect triangle. He turns a page.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Sorry I'm late. I got lost on the road of life.
beats.spokenText: [lazy, bored] Sorry I'm late. I got lost on the road of life.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Two bells. Three of you. Whoever has none goes back to the Academy. Begin.
beats.spokenText: Two bells. Three of you. Whoever has none goes back to the Academy. Begin.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Come at me with the intent to kill. It's the only way you'll ever touch me.
beats.spokenText: Come at me with the intent to kill. It's the only way you'll ever touch me.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: Is he serious? He can't be serious.
beats.spokenText: [uneasy] Is he serious? He can't be serious.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: He's serious. Get ready.
beats.spokenText: [clipped] He's serious. Get ready.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Nobody moves. Then Sasuke opens with a fireball, and Kakashi, for the first time today, has to move.
beats.spokenText: [brisk] Nobody moves. Then Sah-skeh opens with a fireball, and Kah-kah-shee, for the first time today, has to move.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He lands on a wire Naruto strung at dawn. Sakura's kunai cuts it, and a log swings in.
beats.spokenText: He lands on a wire Nah-roo-toh strung at dawn. Sah-koo-rah's koo-nai cuts it, and a log swings in.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kakashi dodges the log, then the kunai, then the second log nobody told him about. He's still holding the book. He's no longer reading it.
beats.spokenText: Kah-kah-shee dodges the log, then the koo-nai, then the second log nobody told him about. He's still holding the book. He's no longer reading it.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Not bad. Whoever planned that.
beats.spokenText: [mildly impressed] Not bad. Whoever planned that.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Then Sasuke throws a windmill shuriken. Kakashi sidesteps it, bored. And the shuriken is Naruto.
beats.spokenText: [building] Then Sah-skeh throws a windmill shuriken. Kah-kah-shee sidesteps it, bored. And the shuriken is Nah-roo-toh.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: In canon, Naruto pulls this exact trick on Zabuza, months from now. He's just early.
beats.spokenText: [gleeful] In canon, Nah-roo-toh pulls this exact trick on Zah-boo-zah, months from now. He's just early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: A hand closes around a bell. Kakashi's one visible eye goes wide.
beats.spokenText: [still] A hand closes around a bell. Kah-kah-shee's one visible eye goes wide.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Wait. Who taught you that?
beats.spokenText: Wait. Who taught you that?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: A lot of me.
beats.spokenText: [grinning] A lot of me.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Sasuke. Catch.
beats.spokenText: [tossing the bell] Sah-skeh. Catch.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: You're giving it to me?
beats.spokenText: You're giving it to me?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I said I would. Two of us have to pass.
beats.spokenText: I said I would. Two of us have to pass.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: You'd hand over your own bell? Then all three of you pass.
beats.spokenText: [dry, quiet] You'd hand over your own bell? Then all three of you pass.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Already?
beats.spokenText: Already?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: It's the first time I've said that. Do not ruin it.
beats.spokenText: It's the first time I've said that. Do not ruin it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It's the first team Kakashi Hatake has ever passed. He does it in ten minutes.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] It's the first team Kah-kah-shee Hah-tah-keh has ever passed. He does it in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: That was actually kind of smart, Naruto.
beats.spokenText: That was actually kind of smart, Nah-roo-toh.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I know. I read it somewhere.
beats.spokenText: I know. I read it somewhere.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Same time tomorrow. Do not be late.
beats.spokenText: [lazy] Same time tomorrow. Do not be late.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: You're the one who's always late.
beats.spokenText: You're the one who's always late.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Right. Fair point.
beats.spokenText: Right. Fair point.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Every team before them failed. This one passed because one boy had read the file.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, final] Every team before them failed. This one passed because one boy had read the file.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: That night, Kakashi stands in the Hokage's office, and for once he doesn't open with a joke.
beats.spokenText: That night, Kah-kah-shee stands in the Hoh-kah-geh's office, and for once he doesn't open with a joke.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: They passed. First try. Ten minutes.
beats.spokenText: They passed. First try. Ten minutes.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Congratulations, Kakashi. You're finally a teacher.
beats.spokenText: [warm] Congratulations, Kah-kah-shee. You're finally a teacher.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: That wasn't a compliment, was it?
beats.spokenText: That wasn't a compliment, was it?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Not entirely.
beats.spokenText: Not entirely.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Tell me. How did Sasuke take it?
beats.spokenText: [curious] Tell me. How did Sah-skeh take it?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: He called him a loser. Then he said thank you. Quietly, so nobody would notice.
beats.spokenText: He called him a loser. Then he said thank you. Quietly, so nobody would notice.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Progress.
beats.spokenText: Progress.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Lord Third. What exactly have you let him read?
beats.spokenText: [level, wary] Lord Third. What exactly have you let him read?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Only what any clerk reads. Forms. Receipts. Reports. He asked politely.
beats.spokenText: Only what any clerk reads. Forms. Receipts. Reports. He asked politely.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: A beat passes. Then another. The Third Hokage studies his pipe as if it has just told a clever joke.
beats.spokenText: A beat passes. Then another. The Third Hoh-kah-geh studies his pipe as if it has just told a clever joke.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Two in the morning. The archive is empty, except for one filing box that isn't a filing box.
beats.spokenText: [low] Two in the morning. The archive is empty, except for one filing box that isn't a filing box.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It's a clone. Naruto left him behind, transformed, to finish the shelf marked off limits.
beats.spokenText: It's a clone. Nah-roo-toh left him behind, transformed, to finish the shelf marked off limits.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Do not breathe loudly. Do not breathe at all. You're a box.
beats.spokenText: Do not breathe loudly. Do not breathe at all. You're a box.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Rule one, touch nothing. Rule two, touch everything. Rule three, don't get caught.
beats.spokenText: [muttering] Rule one, touch nothing. Rule two, touch everything. Rule three, don't get caught.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The off-limits shelf. Twelve years of dust. And one box where a clerk in a hurry filed the wrong sheet. A hospital roster. Medical leave, October, twelve years ago.
beats.spokenText: The off-limits shelf. Twelve years of dust. And one box where a clerk in a hurry filed the wrong sheet. A hospital roster. Medical leave, October, twelve years ago.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: It's alphabetical. One line's inked out. Above it, Uzuki. Below it, Yakushi.
beats.spokenText: [reading, slow] It's alphabetical. One line's inked out. Above it, Oo-zoo-kee. Below it, Yah-koo-shee.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Somebody blacked out the name. Nobody thought to re-alphabetize the page.
beats.spokenText: Somebody blacked out the name. Nobody thought to re-alphabetize the page.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: I've filed the whole clan registry. Exactly one name fits between Uzuki and Yakushi.
beats.spokenText: I've filed the whole clan registry. Exactly one name fits between Oo-zoo-kee and Yah-koo-shee.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He has written that name on every form he has ever signed in his life.
beats.spokenText: [still] He has written that name on every form he has ever signed in his life.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: The leave ends October tenth. That's my birthday.
beats.spokenText: The leave ends October tenth. That's my birthday.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Authorized by the Fourth Hokage.
beats.spokenText: [barely a whisper] Authorized by the Fourth Hoh-kah-geh.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The clone pops. Across the village, Naruto sits bolt upright in bed, holding a memory he never lived.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] The clone pops. Across the village, Nah-roo-toh sits bolt upright in bed, holding a memory he never lived.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Breathe. It's only a clone's memory. It's just a clone's memory.
beats.spokenText: [shaky] Breathe. It's only a clone's memory. It's just a clone's memory.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Uzumaki. There was another one.
beats.spokenText: Oo-zoo-mah-kee. There was another one.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Deep under the seal, in the dark behind the bars, one enormous red eye opens.
beats.spokenText: [slow] Deep under the seal, in the dark behind the bars, one enormous red eye opens.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: A thousand of you, brat. And every one carries a piece of me. Did you think I wasn't reading too?
beats.spokenText: [deep, slow, amused] A thousand of you, brat. And every one carries a piece of me. Did you think I wasn't reading too?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Her name was Kushina. I should know. I lived in her before I lived in you.
beats.spokenText: [deep, quiet] Her name was Koo-shee-nah. I should know. I lived in her before I lived in you.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Before Naruto, the Nine-Tails was sealed inside a woman named Kushina Uzumaki. That part is not a what-if.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] Before Nah-roo-toh, the Nine-Tails was sealed inside a woman named Koo-shee-nah Oo-zoo-mah-kee. That part is not a what-if.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: In Part Two, a twelve year old asks the Third Hokage one question, and the old man has to decide whether to lie to a thousand witnesses.
beats.spokenText: [measured, ominous] In Part Two, a twelve year old asks the Third Hoh-kah-geh one question, and the old man has to decide whether to lie to a thousand witnesses.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old man. Who was Kushina Uzumaki?
beats.spokenText: [low, steady] Old man. Who was Koo-shee-nah Oo-zoo-mah-kee?
